newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Shell Singapore shuts 4,900 tonne/day hydrocracker.
newsitem.headline: Shell Singapore shuts 4,900 tonne/day hydrocracker.

text.p: Shell Singapore has shut down a 4,900 tonne per day hydrocracker at its refinery on December 17, a company spokeswoman said on Wednesday.
"We experienced a boiler leakage in a part of our hyrdocracker complex ... which necessitated a shutdown for engineering works," a company statement said.
The unit is expected to be brought onstream within a few days, Shell said.
A hydrocracker is a secondary unit which processes residual oils into light and middle distillates such as gasoline, jet fuel and diesel.

Shell, the largest refiner in Singapore at 435,000 barrels per day, just resumes full operations of a 10,000 tonne per day thermal cracker on Wednesday morning which was partially closed on December 7 following a leak in a furnace.
